verdict.rationale: Ramp's reimbursements page claims employees can be reimbursed in more than 70 countries and 40 currencies, paid in their local currency within two days. That puts international payouts inside Ramp's own reimbursement flow rather than a separate payments process. The reimbursement workflow itself (submit, approve, accounting sync) is documented across the CLI and integrations, though the international claim rests on a single marketing line. Missing for 10: FX rate and fee details, setup or payout-method documentation for international employees, explicit confirmation that no separate payments rail is needed, independent or hands-on corroboration.
